knowledge.text: Sena and Tahi both asked about the meat preservation experiment at camp tonight. They want to know which method — sun-drying or fire-smoking — is working better. Wiro sees that both are seriously committed to finding the right preservation method. This shared determination gives Wiro confidence that the group will solve the critical problem before winter.

Today after gathering and all the transactions at camp storage, the numbers are: grass seeds 388 handfuls, yams 16, nuts 174 handfuls. The storage grew a little, but not enough. In 7 days winter comes. Everyone must gather and hunt more. The East Forest continues to produce food reliably in summer.
